{"design":"# Plan: Install MinIO in Local k3d Cluster

## Context

The `feat/run-local-k3d` branch is progressively adding local k3d cluster support for
each service. ArangoDB, NATS, modware-annotation, and modware-stock already have local
Pulumi configs and Justfile recipes. MinIO (`minio/main.go`) is a fully implemented
Pulumi module with dev/experiments configs but **no local k3d stack config**.

This plan adds the missing pieces to deploy MinIO in the local k3d cluster following
the exact same pattern used for ArangoDB.

## What Needs to Be Done

Three changes, following existing patterns exactly:

### 1. Create `minio/Pulumi.local.yaml`

Pre-populate non-secret config. Secret values (userName, password) are encrypted and
written by the deploy recipe when first run.

```yaml
secretsprovider: passphrase
config:
  minio:properties:
    chart:
      name: bitnami/minio
      repository: https://charts.bitnami.com/bitnami
      version: 14.7.10
    image:
      tag: "2024.8.3"
    namespace: dev
    secret:
      name: minio-credentials
      passKey: root-password
      userKey: root-user
    storage:
      class: dictycr-balanced
      size: 5Gi
    webui: false
```

Notes:
- `class: dictycr-balanced` matches the k3d StorageClass defined in `storage_class/Pulumi.local.yaml`
- `5Gi` is appropriate for local dev (dev uses `80Gi`)
- `apiIngress` omitted entirely — `APIIngress.Enabled` defaults to `false` (struct zero value), so `createIngress()` returns early; no ingress controller is installed in k3d
- Image tag and chart version match dev for consistency

### 2. Create `just_modules/minio.justfile`

New module with a single `deploy-local-minio` recipe, mirroring `deploy-local-arangodb`
in `just_modules/arangodb.justfile`:

```justfile
[group('minio')]
[no-cd]
deploy-local-minio stack="local" cluster_name=`echo ${K3D_CLUSTER_NAME:-k3d-dev-cluster}` pass_entry="pulumi/local-passphrase" user_pass_entry="minio/local-user" password_pass_entry="minio/local-password":
    #!/usr/bin/env bash
    set -euo pipefail

    if ! PASSPHRASE=$(pass show "{{ pass_entry }}" | head -n 1); then
        echo "Error: Failed to retrieve passphrase from '{{ pass_entry }}'"
        exit 1
    fi
    if ! MINIO_USER=$(pass show "{{ user_pass_entry }}" | head -n 1); then
        echo "Error: Failed to retrieve MinIO username from '{{ user_pass_entry }}'"
        exit 1
    fi
    if ! MINIO_PASSWORD=$(pass show "{{ password_pass_entry }}" | head -n 1); then
        echo "Error: Failed to retrieve MinIO password from '{{ password_pass_entry }}'"
        exit 1
    fi

    KUBECONFIG_FILE=$(mktemp /tmp/k3d-kubeconfig-XXXXXX.yaml)
    cleanup() { rm -f "$KUBECONFIG_FILE"; }
    trap cleanup EXIT

    echo "Exporting k3d kubeconfig..."
    just k3d export-kubeconfig {{ cluster_name }} "$KUBECONFIG_FILE"
    export KUBECONFIG="$KUBECONFIG_FILE"
    export PULUMI_CONFIG_PASSPHRASE="$PASSPHRASE"

    echo "Creating local stack..."
    just local-pulumi new-stack minio {{ stack }} {{ pass_entry }}

    echo "Setting minio config..."
    pulumi -C minio config set-all --stack "{{ stack }}" --path \
        --plaintext "minio:properties.namespace=dev" \
        --plaintext "minio:properties.chart.name=bitnami/minio" \
        --plaintext "minio:properties.chart.repository=https://charts.bitnami.com/bitnami" \
        --plaintext "minio:properties.chart.version=14.7.10" \
        --plaintext "minio:properties.image.tag=2024.8.3" \
        --plaintext "minio:properties.secret.name=minio-credentials" \
        --plaintext "minio:properties.secret.userKey=root-user" \
        --plaintext "minio:properties.secret.passKey=root-password" \
        --plaintext "minio:properties.storage.class=dictycr-balanced" \
        --plaintext "minio:properties.storage.size=5Gi" \
        --secret "minio:properties.secret.userName=$MINIO_USER" \
        --secret "minio:properties.secret.password=$MINIO_PASSWORD"

    echo "Deploying minio..."
    just local-pulumi create-resource minio {{ stack }} {{ pass_entry }}
```

Pass entry defaults:
- `pulumi/local-passphrase` — Pulumi encryption passphrase (shared with all local stacks)
- `minio/local-user` — MinIO root username
- `minio/local-password` — MinIO root password

### 3. Edit `Justfile` — Register the new module

Add one line alongside the existing `mod` declarations (around line 11):

```
mod minio 'just_modules/minio.justfile'
```

## Critical Files

| File | Action |
|------|--------|
| `minio/Pulumi.local.yaml` | CREATE — local k3d stack config |
| `just_modules/minio.justfile` | CREATE — deploy recipe |
| `Justfile` | EDIT — add `mod minio` import |

## Reused Patterns

- `just_modules/arangodb.justfile:deploy-local-arangodb` — exact recipe structure to mirror
- `just_modules/local-pulumi.justfile:new-stack` — stack creation helper
- `just_modules/local-pulumi.justfile:create-resource` — deployment helper
- `just_modules/k3d.justfile:export-kubeconfig` — kubeconfig isolation pattern
- `storage_class/Pulumi.local.yaml` — confirms `dictycr-balanced` storage class name

## Pre-Requisites (before running the recipe)

These must exist before `just minio deploy-local-minio` is called:

1. k3d cluster running (`just k3d create-cluster`)
2. `dictycr-balanced` StorageClass deployed (`just local-pulumi create-resource storage_class`)
3. `dev` namespace created (`just local-pulumi create-resource namespace-bootstrap`)
4. `pass` entries created:
   - `pulumi/local-passphrase` (already exists from arangodb setup)
   - `minio/local-user`
   - `minio/local-password`
5. Pulumi local backend initialized (`just local-pulumi pulumi-local-setup`)

## Verification

After running `just minio deploy-local-minio`:

```bash
# Check pod is running
KUBECONFIG=$(k3d kubeconfig get k3d-dev-cluster) kubectl get pods -n dev -l app.kubernetes.io/name=minio

# Check PVC is bound
KUBECONFIG=$(k3d kubeconfig get k3d-dev-cluster) kubectl get pvc -n dev

# Test MinIO API via port-forward
KUBECONFIG=$(k3d kubeconfig get k3d-dev-cluster) kubectl port-forward -n dev svc/minio-credentials 9000:9000 &
mc alias set local http://localhost:9000 <user> <password>
mc ls local
```"}
